title: Valor MN
author: Valor Classical Academy
description: Valor is a partnership between parents to raise our children in the Lord. We're entering year three, and our school is growing up; the concrete of our culture is setting. So it's crucial that we are all on the same page with respect to who we are and where we're going. Each week I'll send our community a short article to explain what Valor is becoming and where it is going.
